fixes.explanation: Moses was Israel's leader (Exodus 3:10), so I get the thought. But Paul names a different person as the one mediator between God and men. It's the man Christ Jesus (1 Timothy 2:5). Moses doesn't show up anywhere in this passage.

Jesus taught plenty (Mark 4:2), but that's not the word Paul uses. He says Christ Jesus gave Himself as a ransom for all (1 Timothy 2:6). A ransom is a price paid, and it's a much bigger thing than a lesson. Jesus said it Himself: “…to give His life as a ransom for many.” (Mark 10:45).

True. Paul says, “For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.” (1 Timothy 2:13). The man was formed first (Genesis 2:7), and the woman was made after (Genesis 2:22). Paul states it plainly and I'll leave it as he says it.

This one's actually true. Paul says, “For Adam was formed first, and then Eve.” (1 Timothy 2:13). The man was formed first (Genesis 2:7), and the woman was made after (Genesis 2:22). It's right there in the verse, friend.
